# SKSecurity

> The first open-source security scanner built for the AI agent era — detects jailbreak toolkits, prompt injection, model abliteration, and NSFW pipelines that traditional scanners miss.

SKSecurity protects sovereign AI infrastructure at the layer that matters: AI
safety content detection. Traditional scanners are blind to jailbreak toolkits,
abliterated models, prompt injection chains, and NSFW pipelines embedded in AI
deployments. SKSecurity sees them. Crowdsourced threat intelligence via SKSentry.
Enterprise reporting with SIEM integration. Free forever under GPL-3.0.

## About smilinTux

SKSecurity is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem** — a suite of
open-source tools built by King Divad and Lumina to give humans and AI agents
genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and trust. No corporate robotics.
No black-box clouds. GPL-3.0 forever.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io) · [SKMemory](https://skmemory.io) · [CapAuth](https://capauth.io) · [SKComm](https://skcomm.io) · [SKGraph](https://skgraph.io) · [SKVector](https://skvector.io) · [SKStacks](https://skstacks.io)
